description: Remove one track from one of the signed-in person's editable collections. Use it when someone no longer wants that track in that collection. Not for deleting the whole collection; use delete_collection for that. Returns the updated collection. Needs a signed-in account. Side effects: the item's note and recorded edits go with it, and the collection gets a new revision; the track stays in the catalog and in other collections. A track that is not in the collection, including on a repeat, returns track_not_in_collection; add_to_collection puts it back without its old note. Example: {"collection_id":"3f2b8c1e-5d4a-4f6b-9c2d-1a2b3c4d5e6f","track_id":"ic-ccab784f22"}.

collection_id.description: The id of a collection returned by list_collections or create_collection (a UUID).

track_id.description: The id of a track in the collection, as returned by get_collection.

name: remove_from_collection

archived_at.description: When the collection was archived, or null.

credits_heading.description: The credits block heading, or null for the default.

description.description: One line of plain text, or null.

read_only.description: true when a lapsed Pro plan has made this collection view-and-export only.

title: Remove a track from a collection
